mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.dept_id, #{shopDeptId} as shop_dept_id, p.base_salary, p.post_salary, p.field_allowance, p.performance_salary, p.salary_total from sys_user u left join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id where exists ( select 1 from oa_attendance_schedule s where s.user_id = u.user_id and s.shop_id = #{shopDeptId} and s.status = 'PUBLISHED' and s.business_date >= concat(#{salaryMonth}, '-01') and s.business_date < date_add( str_to_date(concat(#{salaryMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 month) ) or exists ( select 1 from oa_salary_record r where r.user_id = u.user_id and r.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and r.salary_month = #{salaryMonth} ) or ( u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and (p.entry_date is null or p.entry_date < date_add( str_to_date(concat(#{salaryMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 month)) and (p.leave_date is null or p.leave_date >= concat(#{salaryMonth}, '-01')) and ( u.dept_id = #{shopDeptId} or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_shop us where us.user_id = u.user_id and us.dept_id = #{shopDeptId} ) ) ) order by u.user_id asc
